text_block_list.text:
Afterward the race, Сайленс Судзука is
filled with a
rare excitement, and raves
about the beautiful
scenery she
witnessed during the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Many Umamusume are inspired by this
race, the
flames in their hearts stoked to
a blazing roar.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
